lines.text: Those who hide their plans from the LORD work in darkness and treat the potter as if he were clay.
In a very short time, Lebanon will become an orchard, and the orchard will seem like a forest.
On that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and the humble will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
The ruthless will vanish and the mockers will disappear, because they deprive the innocent of justice with false charges.
The LORD who redeemed Abraham says Jacob will be ashamed no longer, and the grumblers will accept instruction.
